eyebrow: The shape to flag in a policy review
code:
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["iam:PassRole", "ec2:RunInstances"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
# PassRole + RunInstances scoped to "*" is a textbook
# escalation primitive — not malicious by itself, but it
# needs a documented reason to exist unscoped
caption: Rhino Security Labs' catalog of ~20 AWS IAM escalation methods all share this shape.

eyebrow: Azure's version of the same logic
code:
# the one action every Azure RBAC escalation path depends on
Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write
# held by: Owner, User Access Administrator

# Application Administrator can add a NEW secret to an
# EXISTING app registration it did not create —
# including one already granted high-privilege Graph scopes
caption: Find the action that lets an identity grant itself more access — that's the escalation path.
